prompt:
9:16 vertical photorealistic beauty portrait taken in a bright white interior. Fictional adult Japanese female, appearing 25-31 years old. Close-up half-body shot from top of head to below chest. Person in center, body slightly right, face slightly down. Gaze directed to the lower right, with a soft smile showing teeth modestly. Right hand placed at the lower left of the chin, index and middle fingers along the neck. Wrist naturally bent, five fingers with accurate length, joints, and nails.
Hair is deep dark brown near black, longer than collarbone, straight to loose inward curls. Left-leaning side part, left side tucked behind ear, right side flowing thickly in front of shoulder. A few natural stray hairs on the surface. Not too large dark brown eyes, thin eyeliner, natural lashes, light pink-beige eyeshadow, coral blush, and pale rose-pink lips. Soft highlights on the bridge of the nose and cheekbones. Skin is bright and clean but retains pores, fine hairs, and lip texture.
Outfit is an ivory long-sleeved blouse. Fine vertical pleats, round neckline, small matching buttons, and fine gathers at the cuffs. No accessories. Background is a white wall and pale beige windowsill, with very small greenery of a houseplant blurred in the distance. Soft diffused light from a large window in the front left, with a white reflector on the right to keep shadows shallow. High key, warm cream color, and gradations that are not overexposed.
85mm equivalent, f/2.0, camera slightly higher than eye level. Precise focus on the near eye, eyelashes, and fingertips, with background and back side of hair softly blurred. No text, logos, watermarks, jewelry, dark nails, extra fingers, fused fingers, distorted wrists, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin smoothing, porcelain skin, strong sharpness, or CG feel.

promptZh:
9:16 竖构图写实美妆人像，拍摄于明亮的白色室内。虚构的成年日本女性，年龄设定为 25-31 岁。从头顶到胸部下方的半身特写镜头。人物居中，身体略微偏右，面部微低。视线看向右下方，带着柔和的微笑，露出牙齿。右手置于下巴左下方，食指和中指贴合颈部。手腕自然弯曲，五指长度、关节和指甲精准。
头发为深棕色近黑色，长度过锁骨，直发至内扣卷发。左侧偏分，左侧头发别在耳后，右侧头发厚实地垂在肩前。表面有少量自然的碎发。深棕色双眼大小适中，画着细眼线，睫毛自然，浅粉米色眼影，珊瑚色腮红，淡玫瑰粉色嘴唇。鼻梁和颧骨处有柔和的高光。皮肤明亮洁净，但保留了毛孔、细小绒毛和唇纹。
服装为 象牙白长袖衬衫。带有细密的垂直褶皱，圆领设计，配有同色小纽扣，袖口有细致的褶皱。无配饰。背景为 白色墙壁和淡米色窗台，远处有模糊的室内绿植。柔和的漫射光从左前方的大窗户射入，右侧配有白色反光板以保持阴影浅淡。高调摄影，暖奶油色调，过渡自然，不过曝。
85mm 等效焦距，f/2.0 光圈，相机位置略高于视线水平。焦点精准对准近处的眼睛、睫毛和指尖，背景和后脑勺头发柔和虚化。无文字、Logo、水印、珠宝、深色指甲、多余手指、手指粘连、手腕扭曲、双眼不对称、过度磨皮、瓷器感皮肤、过强锐化或 CG 感。
